column1: # Single source of truth, read by BOTH
# `gradle/phase5/phase5g-inventories.gradle`. It must not be duplicated in
# either: a hand-copied second list is how a scanned tree ends up undeclared as
# a Gradle input, which lets a stale UP-TO-DATE result hide a new extension
# surface and leaves the gate green while the thing it claims to prove is false.
#   extension  - a reactor project whose code can extend the web UI. `base` and
#                `client` are deliberately absent: they are the core.
#   client-set - the per-client `MODELVALIDATIONCLASSES` overlay project. It is
#                not an extension project, but the GardenWorld seed registers
#                `compiere.model.MyValidator` from it, so it is on a Phase 5g
#                fixture path and must be inventoried.
#   web-ui     - the web UI itself. Scanned only for ZK form controllers, not
